2023-4518-4742-6006.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kor Skyfisher and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1809-4826-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
1809-4826-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Returned Pastcaller and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Returned Pastcaller and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.
1809-4826-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Returned Pastcaller and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

250-779-1479-6620-7889.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-6620-7889.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-6620-7889.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Dancing from Dark to Dawn and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

215-3443-7297.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-7297.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-7297.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

4885-7686-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
4885-7686-7763.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
4885-7686-7763.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2173-2469-3845-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Panicked Bystander // Cackling Culprit trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

2523-2869-5633.description:
Cast Fleshbag Marauder by paying its mana cost.
When Fleshbag Marauder enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Fleshbag Marauder dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Fleshbag Marauder that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Fleshbag Marauder token instead.

513-5437-6896.easyPrerequisites:
You have a nonland permanent card in hand that costs {2} or less.
You control a nontoken nonland permanent that costs {2} or less.
513-5437-6896.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a nonland permanent card that costs {2} or less.
Cast the permanent from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {0} due to Green Goblin.
Hullbreaker Horror trigger, returning another nonland permaennt that costs 2 or less from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 2.
Repeat.

5088-5147-5148-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three basic lands.
5088-5147-5148-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
5088-5147-5148-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping basic lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Early Harvest with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Early Harvest from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Early Harvest by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Early Harvest.
Resolve a copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Early Harvest, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Early Harvest.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

2034-5003-7265.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Neriv, adding {C}{C}.
When Neriv dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Neriv from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Neriv enters, it triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

628-3723-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

3375-3532-4997-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
3375-3532-4997-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

826-1636-2921-6935.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, causing Otherworldly Escort to lose all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
When Otherworldly Escort enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

997-1482-2866-4986.description:
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2034-4927-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

2919-3197-6458.easyPrerequisites:
Thunder of Unity's second or third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
You have a way to gain life.
2919-3197-6458.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Thunder of Unity triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2793-3017-3743-5089-6753.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3017-3743-5089-6753.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Ghostly Pilferer by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least three loyalty counters on it

328-598-2452-5670.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Gray Merchant from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rooftop Storm.
When Gray Merchant enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain that much life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gray Merchant, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5220-5683.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can be cast using {C}{C}.
2034-5220-5683.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature that can be cast using {C}{C}, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for the creature and putting it into your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

578-4222-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two artifact cards in hand.
578-4222-5115.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, causing you to reveal at least two artifact cards from your hand and add at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

1927-2686-4274.description:
During the end step before your turn, cast Barren Glory by paying {4}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Apocalypse by paying {2}{R}{R}{R}, exiling all permanents and causing you to discard your hand.
Resolve Barren Glory.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Barren Glory triggers, causing you to win the game.

1810-2743-4285.description:
Cast Cackling Counterpart by paying {1}{U}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {3}{R}{R}, copying Cackling Counterpart twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Cackling Counterparts, creating three token copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

372-1430-3908.description:
Cast Spark Double by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
When Spark Double enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Abdel Adrian until Spark Double leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, Mirror Image returns from exile to the battlefield as a copy of Spark Double.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Spark Double until Mirror Image leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Spark Double leaves the battlefield, Abdel Adrian returns from exile to the battlefield.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Mirror Image until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, Spark Double returns to the battlefield from exile as a nonlegendary copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

939-2397-3821-4404.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {4}.
939-2397-3821-4404.description:
Cast Soul Foundry by paying {4}.
Soul Foundry enters the battlefield, triggering its imprint ability twice, exiling Peregrine Drake and Corridor Monitor.
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {7} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake and Corridor Monitor.
The Peregrine Drake and Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities twice.
Resolve both Corridor Monitor triggers, untapping Soul Foundry.
Resolve the first Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2160-2239-2647-3337.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} on your first turn, with {2}{R}{R} available on all subsequent turns
2160-2239-2647-3337.notablePrerequisites: Reflection of Kiki-Jiki does not have summoning sickness.
2160-2239-2647-3337.description:
Cast Warrior's Oath by paying {R}{R}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Reflection of Kiki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Ardent Elementalist.
The Ardent Elementalist token enters the battlefield, returning Warrior's Oath from your graveyard to your hand.
At the beginning of each extra turn's end step, Warrior's Oath triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sundial of the Infinite by paying {1} and tapping it, ending the turn.
Repeat each turn.

2173-2853-4996.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 12 if Beacon of Immortality is in your library, or you have {5}{W} available if it's in your hand.
2173-2853-4996.description:
Activate Thought Lash by exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 1 until you either exile your library or have Beacon of Immortality on top of your library.
Resolve all Thought Lash abilities.
Cast Beacon of Immortality either from your hand by paying {5}{W} or from the top of your library by paying 6 life, doubling your life total and shuffling it into your library.
If Beacon of Immortality is not on top of your library, repeat from step 1. Otherwise, repeat step 4.

3236-4821.notablePrerequisites:
You control nonland permanents that can produce {1}{U}.
You control an additional Wizard.
3236-4821.description:
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
In response, activate Sigil Tracer by paying {1}{U} and tapping two untapped Wizards, copying Dramatic Reversal.
Let the copy resolve, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

2882-3092-4675-4694.notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Cavalier of Dawn.
2882-3092-4675-4694.description:
Cast Orochi Hatchery by paying {0}.
Orochi Hatchery enters the battlefield as a copy of Cavalier of Dawn.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, destroying itself and creating you a 3/3 Golem token.
Copy of Cavalier of Dawn dies, triggering itself, returning Orochi Hatchery from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
